principles: No invented practitioner credentials, languages or interests
Approved visual design is not altered by routine content updates

roles.contentEditor: Maintains copy, links, non-clinical factual information and media metadata.
roles.clinicalReviewer: A real authorised clinician signs substantive clinical content after checking patient safety, accuracy, sources and restrictions; operational/institutional items go to an appropriately authorised reviewer, not a fabricated clinician.
roles.practiceManager: Approves operational information, policies, hours and governance content for publication.
roles.webPublisher: Publishes approved content into the existing templates without redesigning them.
roles.contentOwner: Accountable person/department identifies the page, validates proposed content and submits it for review with their real identity and submission date.
roles.practiceApprover: A separate authorised practice approver signs off after review; no publication before approval.

clinicalReview.displayRule: Only records from generated registry (status approved, actual complete evidence, reviewer, dates, department) are displayed. Pending content is silent.
requiredFor: clinical governance content where clinical review is appropriate

reviewCadence: Review on material clinical or policy change and at the organisation's formally adopted review interval. Never publish a review date that did not arise from a genuine review.
designChangeControl: Homepage, hero, visual identity, community section, services overview and patient-information hub require explicit design-governance approval before structural change.

approvalSequence: Content Owner submits the final content and records their real identity and submission date.
Correct reviewer category is identified; an appropriate clinical, operational or institutional reviewer completes a genuine review and signs with date.
Authorised approver signs AFTER review and approves the next review due date.
Private evidence and actual staff identities are recorded outside webroot with approval reference and exact reviewed content fingerprint.
Publish only the approved four-field public subset using the builder and verify --check before release.
Material page edits or review expiry require a new cycle; mark private status in_review/review_due and rebuild to suppress outdated public metadata.
rules: A page must not show review metadata without an approved record containing complete actual evidence.
Only public fields (reviewedBy, lastReviewed, nextReview, contentOwner) are emitted. Approval and evidence references remain unpublished.
No automatic review-date values, default reviewer attribution, or publication-date fallback.
For a substantive clinical/policy edit, set review status in_review and remove public review metadata until a new review is approved.
Practice manager must validate the accountable department for each page.
Operational and third-party provider pages must not imply clinical endorsement without clinical review.
Never publish the private clinical approval evidence; only the generated approved public JS subset is deployed.
Review signoff date must match Last Reviewed; owner submission, review, approval and next due must be in chronological order.
The public Reviewed by field must represent the real approving review body; it is never prefilled from a suggested default.
Every clinical record must have a real appropriately authorised clinician who reviewed the page, retained privately.
Production release must re-run --check with the external private evidence source; hashes ensure that approved content has not changed.
reviewPublication.privateApprovals: Pass with --approvals from a secure file OUTSIDE the deployed public site root
reviewPublication.coverageGate: cms/tools/check_governance_framework.py --check (Knowledge Centre, service authority, patient information and governance pages)
reviewPublication.expiryRule: A missed Next Review due date invalidates current public review attribution: renewal needs a fresh signed evidence record and matching content fingerprint. Review due today stays valid through the local day.
reviewPublication.deploymentGate: The release builder checks both scope and published approval evidence; with approved records the matching PRIVATE approvals file must be passed via --governance-approvals outside webroot.
